issues.description: Trusted helpers that produce tracked owners use the legacy verifier::returns(proof) attribute and ordinary return binders instead of declaring tracked return values directly.
issues.rationale: The selected original review head renames resource-producing helpers with the `tracked_` prefix, but still expresses their return mode through the legacy `#[verifier::returns(proof)]` attribute and either an ordinary `Self` return or an ordinary named `res`. Review comment 3286965930 asks whether the return should instead be `(tracked res: Self)`. The author explicitly agrees, the reviewer confirms that an `axiom fn` can directly return `tracked res`, and the final approved head removes all ten `returns(proof)` attributes in `ostd/` and uses named tracked results. The later official `avoid-redundant-mode-markers` rule requires `tracked` markers where they communicate or enforce a mode boundary; it postdates this review and is used to adjudicate this concrete, accepted migration rather than inventing a new rule.

The final head uses `-> (tracked res: Self)` and contains zero `#[verifier::returns(proof)]` attributes under `ostd/`.
